items.title: Physical Natural Gas Prices Peter Out as Weather Cools, Maintenance Trims LNG Volumes
items.summary: Spot natural gas prices wilted on Monday as mild temperatures canvassed the North and southern heat showed signs of easing.

items.title: As Heat Recedes, Natural Gas Futures Retreat
items.summary: Natural gas futures pulled back on Monday amid healthy supply readings and forecasts for benign weather through the final stretch of September and into early October.

items.title: Appalachian Natural Gas Prices Hit 2-Year Lows as Cove Point Outage Begins
items.summary: Cove Point LNG went offline Saturday for annual maintenance, pulling roughly 0.85 Bcf/d of feedgas demand out of Appalachia as six regional natural gas hubs traded at their lowest prices since November 2024.

items.title: Cooler Eastern US Cuts Gas Demand as Appalachia Storms Build
items.summary: A sharp cooldown across the eastern United States is cutting late-season natural gas demand as storms threaten Appalachia, while heat holds across Texas and the Gulf Coast.

items.title: Florida Natural Gas Constraints Spur $2.4B Pipeline Expansion Push
items.summary: Florida Gas Transmission (FGT) has filed a Federal Energy Regulatory Commission Section 7(c) application for its $1.22 billion Phase 9 Expansion Project, aimed at relieving growing pipeline bottlenecks in the Sunshine State.

items.title: Global Gas Prices Slide Despite Deepening Middle East LNG Supply Risks
items.summary: Global natural gas prices fell on Monday ahead of a series of meetings between global leaders scheduled for this week and renewed hopes for diplomacy in the Middle East even though the conflict there has widened.

items.title: Natural Gas Prices Sputter as Consumers Idle Air Conditioners
items.summary: New York Mercantile Exchange natural gas futures traded firmly in the red at midday on Monday as market participants focused on forecasts for mild fall weather to gain substantial ground this week.

items.title: September Heat Eases, but US Natural Gas Storage Picture Continues to Tighten
items.summary: The Lower 48 did experience a bit of relief from September heat last week, as cooling degree days (CDDs) fell to 61 from 72 week/week, according to NGI calculations of National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) data.

items.title: PJM Weighs Greater Reliability Credit for Firm Natural Gas Supply
items.summary: The largest US grid operator spanning the Mid-Atlantic and parts of the Midwest is deciding whether natural gas-fired power plants with firm pipeline transportation or storage should receive more credit for reliability.

items.title: Natural Gas Power Demand Keeps Climbing Despite Milder Winters
items.summary: Natural gas-fired generation is adding another layer of winter demand, with the upcoming season’s power burn forecast at 33.8 Bcf/d, up 5.5 Bcf/d from five winters ago even as milder weather tempers heating needs, according to the American Gas Associ
